Safer watering and correct vegie job dates.

## Fixes

- **Valves close reliably.** If a valve does not close, the garden keeps trying every minute until it does. After a restart, saved valve runs wait for your valve integrations to load before closing.
- **Vegie jobs show the right dates.** One-off jobs such as bed prep and harvest no longer show a due date a year ago, and they no longer come back two years later.
- **Frost watering stays in the day.** It only starts within 6 hours of the frost watering time. A frost forecast that arrives in the evening is skipped, and the activity log says why.
- **Rain counts once.** Rain that falls before midnight no longer counts as watering again the next day.
- **Valve services find the right garden** when you have more than one, and only run valves, switches and input booleans.

## Removed

- The unused Planted date in the plant settings.
